name: sampling handles negative logits, stable extremes, replacement and generator
test:
import torch
logits = torch.tensor([[-2., 0.], [-1000., 1000.]])
g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(7)
x = sample_responses(logits, 8000, g)
assert x.shape == (2, 8000) and x.dtype == torch.long
assert (x[1] == 1).all()
assert .85 < (x[0] == 1).float().mean().item() < .90
assert torch.equal(sample_responses(torch.tensor([[0.]]), 4, torch.Generator().manual_seed(1)), torch.zeros((1, 4), dtype=torch.long))
assert torch.equal(sample_responses(logits, 5, torch.Generator().manual_seed(9)), sample_responses(logits, 5, torch.Generator().manual_seed(9)))

name: advantages normalize rows and detach including constant and singleton groups
test:
import torch
r = torch.tensor([[1.,3.],[5.,5.]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
a = group_advantages(r, eps=1.)
assert a.dtype == r.dtype and not a.requires_grad
assert torch.allclose(a, torch.tensor([[-.5,.5],[0.,0.]], dtype=r.dtype))
assert torch.equal(group_advantages(torch.tensor([[2.],[8.]])), torch.zeros((2,1)))
assert torch.allclose(group_advantages(torch.tensor([[1.,3.]]), eps=1e-6), torch.tensor([[-1/1.000001,1/1.000001]]))

name: rollout stores independent frozen snapshots with repeated prompts
test:
import torch
initial = torch.tensor([[0.,2.], [3.,0.]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
table = torch.tensor([[1.,4.], [8.,2.]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
ids = torch.tensor([0,0,1])
t = GRPOTrainer(initial)
b = t.rollout(ids, table, 4, torch.Generator().manual_seed(12))
assert set(b) == {'prompt_ids','responses','rewards','old_logprobs'}
assert b['responses'].shape == (3,4) and b['responses'].dtype == torch.long
for key in b:
 assert not b[key].requires_grad
expected = torch.log_softmax(initial.detach()[ids], -1).gather(1,b['responses'])
assert torch.allclose(b['old_logprobs'], expected)
assert torch.equal(b['rewards'], table.detach()[ids].gather(1,b['responses']))
saved = {k:v.clone() for k,v in b.items()}
with torch.no_grad():
 t.policy_logits[0] += torch.tensor([2.,-2.], dtype=t.policy_logits.dtype)
 initial.add_(30.)
 table.add_(30.)
 ids.fill_(1)
assert all(torch.equal(b[k], v) for k,v in saved.items())
assert torch.equal(t.reference_logits, torch.tensor([[0.,2.],[3.,0.]], dtype=torch.float64))

name: stale importance ratio uses exponent and sign-sensitive clipping
test:
import torch
p = torch.tensor([[.25,.75],[.25,.75]], dtype=torch.float64).log()
t = GRPOTrainer(p, beta=0., clip_eps=.2, eps=1.)
responses = torch.tensor([[0,1],[0,1]])
old = torch.full((2,2), -.6931471805599453, dtype=torch.float64)
b = {'prompt_ids':torch.tensor([0,1]), 'responses':responses, 'rewards':torch.tensor([[0.,2.],[2.,0.]], dtype=torch.float64), 'old_logprobs':old}
current = torch.log_softmax(t.policy_logits[b['prompt_ids']], -1).gather(1, responses)
ratios = (current.detach() - old).exp()
assert torch.allclose(ratios, torch.tensor([[.5,1.5],[.5,1.5]], dtype=torch.float64), atol=1e-12)
a = torch.tensor([[-.5,.5],[.5,-.5]], dtype=torch.float64)
expected = -torch.minimum(ratios*a, ratios.clamp(.8,1.2)*a).mean()
loss = t.loss(b)
assert torch.allclose(loss, expected, atol=1e-12)
assert abs(loss.item() - .075) < 1e-12
loss.backward()
assert torch.allclose(t.policy_logits.grad, torch.tensor([[0.,0.],[-.09375,.09375]], dtype=torch.float64), atol=1e-12)
assert not torch.allclose(loss, -(ratios*a).mean())
assert not torch.allclose(loss, -((current.detach()-old)*a).mean())

name: exact forward KL uses prompt rows and keeps reference fixed
test:
import torch
p = torch.tensor([[1.,-1.],[-2.,2.]],dtype=torch.float64)
t = GRPOTrainer(p,beta=.7)
with torch.no_grad():
 t.policy_logits[0] += torch.tensor([1.,-1.],dtype=p.dtype)
 t.policy_logits[1] += torch.tensor([2.,-2.],dtype=p.dtype)
ids = torch.tensor([0,1,0])
b = {'prompt_ids':ids,'responses':torch.zeros((3,2),dtype=torch.long),'rewards':torch.ones((3,2),dtype=p.dtype),'old_logprobs':torch.zeros((3,2),dtype=p.dtype)}
cur = torch.log_softmax(t.policy_logits[ids],-1)
ref = torch.log_softmax(p[ids],-1)
expected = .7*(cur.exp()*(cur-ref)).sum(-1).mean()
reverse = .7*(ref.exp()*(ref-cur)).sum(-1).mean()
assert not torch.allclose(expected,reverse)
assert torch.allclose(t.loss(b),expected,atol=1e-12)
assert torch.equal(t.reference_logits,p)

name: loss gradients reach policy only and preserve supplied batch
test:
import torch
p = torch.tensor([[.1,.9]],dtype=torch.float64,requires_grad=True)
t = GRPOTrainer(p,beta=.3)
b = {'prompt_ids':torch.tensor([0]),'responses':torch.tensor([[0,1]]),'rewards':torch.tensor([[1.,3.]],dtype=p.dtype,requires_grad=True),'old_logprobs':torch.tensor([[-1.2,-.4]],dtype=p.dtype,requires_grad=True)}
saved = {k:v.detach().clone() for k,v in b.items()}
loss = t.loss(b)
assert loss.ndim == 0 and loss.requires_grad
loss.backward()
assert t.policy_logits.grad is not None and t.policy_logits.grad.abs().sum() > 0
assert p.grad is None and b['rewards'].grad is None and b['old_logprobs'].grad is None
assert all(torch.equal(b[k].detach(),v) for k,v in saved.items())

name: step returns pre-update loss and follows fresh SGD gradient each call
test:
import torch
p = torch.tensor([[0.,0.]],dtype=torch.float64)
t = GRPOTrainer(p,learning_rate=.2,beta=0.,eps=1.)
b = {'prompt_ids':torch.tensor([0]),'responses':torch.tensor([[0,1]]),'rewards':torch.tensor([[0.,2.]],dtype=p.dtype),'old_logprobs':torch.tensor([[-.7,-.7]],dtype=p.dtype)}
saved = {k:v.clone() for k,v in b.items()}
for _ in range(2):
 before = t.policy_logits.detach().clone()
 loss = t.loss(b)
 grad = torch.autograd.grad(loss,t.policy_logits)[0]
 value = t.step(b)
 assert isinstance(value,float) and abs(value-float(loss.detach())) < 1e-12
 assert torch.allclose(t.policy_logits.detach(),before-.2*grad,atol=1e-12)
assert torch.equal(t.reference_logits,p)
assert all(torch.equal(b[k],v) for k,v in saved.items())

name: seeded multi-step rollout remains finite and stale ratio changes
test:
import torch
p = torch.tensor([[0.,0.],[1.,-1.]],dtype=torch.float64)
t = GRPOTrainer(p,learning_rate=.05,beta=.02)
ids = torch.tensor([0,1,0])
table = torch.tensor([[0.,1.],[1.,0.]],dtype=p.dtype)
b = t.rollout(ids,table,16,torch.Generator().manual_seed(3))
assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in b.values())
old = b['old_logprobs'].clone()
for _ in range(3):
 value = t.step(b)
 assert isinstance(value,float) and torch.isfinite(torch.tensor(value))
 assert torch.isfinite(t.policy_logits).all()
assert torch.equal(b['old_logprobs'],old)
new = torch.log_softmax(t.policy_logits[ids],-1).gather(1,b['responses'])
assert (new-old).abs().max() > 0

name: reference snapshot is independent of initialization and current logits
test:
import torch
initial = torch.tensor([[0., 1., -1.], [2., -2., 0.]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
saved = initial.detach().clone()
t = GRPOTrainer(initial)
assert isinstance(t.policy_logits, torch.nn.Parameter)
assert t.policy_logits.requires_grad and not t.reference_logits.requires_grad
with torch.no_grad():
 initial[0].add_(torch.tensor([3., -4., 2.], dtype=initial.dtype))
assert torch.equal(t.policy_logits, saved), 'Current policy must own a copy of the input'
assert torch.equal(t.reference_logits, saved), 'Reference must own a copy of initialization'
with torch.no_grad():
 t.policy_logits[1].add_(torch.tensor([-1., 2., 4.], dtype=initial.dtype))
assert not torch.equal(t.policy_logits, saved)
assert torch.equal(t.reference_logits, saved), 'Reference must stay fixed when current logits change; detach alone shares storage'

name: clipping selects pessimistic branch for both advantage signs
test:
import torch
# Current/old action ratios are 1.6 and 0.4. Advantages are +/-0.5.
# Reward order makes both moves either beneficial (clipped) or harmful (unclipped).
for c in (0., .2, .4):
 t = GRPOTrainer(torch.tensor([[.8, .2]], dtype=torch.float64).log(), beta=0., clip_eps=c, eps=1.)
 for rewards, expected_loss, expected_gradient in (
  ([[2., 0.]], -c / 2, [[0., 0.]]),
  ([[0., 2.]], .3, [[.16, -.16]]),
 ):
  b = {'prompt_ids': torch.tensor([0]), 'responses': torch.tensor([[0, 1]]),
       'rewards': torch.tensor(rewards, dtype=torch.float64),
       'old_logprobs': torch.full((1, 2), .5, dtype=torch.float64).log()}
  loss = t.loss(b)
  assert abs(loss.item() - expected_loss) < 1e-12, 'Clip beneficial changes but retain penalties for harmful changes'
  grad = torch.autograd.grad(loss, t.policy_logits)[0]
  assert torch.allclose(grad, torch.tensor(expected_gradient, dtype=torch.float64), atol=1e-12, rtol=0.), 'Clipped incentives must be flat; corrective gradients must remain active'

name: step clears preexisting gradients and does not reuse stale gradients
test:
import torch
t = GRPOTrainer(torch.zeros((1, 2), dtype=torch.float64), learning_rate=.2, beta=0., eps=1.)
b = {'prompt_ids': torch.tensor([0]), 'responses': torch.tensor([[0, 1]]),
     'rewards': torch.tensor([[0., 2.]], dtype=torch.float64),
     'old_logprobs': torch.full((1, 2), .5, dtype=torch.float64).log()}
# A fresh on-policy surrogate has value zero but gradient [0.25, -0.25].
t.policy_logits.grad = torch.tensor([[7., -3.]], dtype=torch.float64)
value = t.step(b)
assert isinstance(value, float) and abs(value) < 1e-12
assert torch.allclose(t.policy_logits, torch.tensor([[-.05, .05]], dtype=torch.float64), atol=1e-12, rtol=0.), 'Clear preexisting gradients before applying the fresh SGD update'
# A neutral batch has zero advantage and zero policy gradient, even after a real update.
neutral = {key: value.clone() for key, value in b.items()}
neutral['rewards'].fill_(1.)
before = t.policy_logits.detach().clone()
value = t.step(neutral)
assert isinstance(value, float) and abs(value) < 1e-12
assert torch.equal(t.policy_logits, before), 'A zero-gradient batch must not reuse the previous step gradient'
assert torch.equal(b['rewards'], torch.tensor([[0., 2.]], dtype=torch.float64))
